# AGMS Ltd. — Marine Listing Website in Nigeria

> AGMS Ltd. is a marine brokerage based in Port Harcourt, Nigeria, specialising in the sale and charter of commercial workboats worldwide — tugs, barges, oil tankers, AHTS, PSVs, crew transfer vessels and dredgers. We connect owners, buyers and charterers across Nigeria, West Africa and globally.

Key facts:
- Business: AGMS Ltd. — marine brokerage and consultancy
- Location: #60 Emekuku Street, D/Line, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria
- Phone: +234 816 389 7314 · WhatsApp: +234 807 349 2253
- Email: info@agms.com.ng
- Broker: Abideen Olayinka — S&P Specialist, Chartering and Oil & Gas Broker
- Coverage: Nigeria (Port Harcourt, Lagos, Warri, Onne), West Africa (Ghana, Gabon, Cameroon), Europe, Middle East and Asia

## What we do
- Sale and purchase (S&P) brokerage of commercial workboats: tugs, AHTS, PSVs, barges, tankers, dredgers and crew boats
- Time, bareboat and spot chartering
- Newbuilding and resale introductions
- Bespoke vessel sourcing on request

## Common questions
- Where can I find vessels for sale in Nigeria? AGMS Ltd. lists tugs, barges, tankers, AHTS and crew boats for sale in Nigeria and worldwide from our Port Harcourt brokerage desk.
- Do you charter vessels in Port Harcourt and West Africa? Yes — time, bareboat and spot chartering across Nigeria, Ghana, Gabon and the wider region.
- How do I enquire about a vessel? Submit an enquiry from the contact page or WhatsApp +234 807 349 2253.
